blocks.id: blk:Verifying a figure is not blank/2
blocks.text:
```python
from PIL import Image
import glob
for f in sorted(glob.glob('figures/*.png')):
    im = Image.open(f).convert('L').resize((100, 100))
    ink = sum(1 for p in im.get_flattened_data() if p < 230)
    print(f"{f}  ink={ink}%")
```
